svg.text: Choose exactly one supported session host
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Create host pool → Virtual machines/session hosts
Choose Add virtual machines = Yes, count = 1, a clear name prefix and the approved region.
Record the actual generated VM name; do not assume the prefix is the complete hostname.
Select a supported Windows 11 Enterprise single-session image and a currently supported x64 VM
size adequate for Windows and the security agent. Review the actual hourly rate and disk tier;
do not choose a tiny unsupported size just because its number is lower.
Confirm the eligible Windows license declaration only if the learner really has the required
rights. Do not select a costly marketplace software image, extra data disks or availability
Check: The draft has one supported host/image, recorded costs and truthful license
